# Copilot Instructions

Governing thought: Follow repository authority and make work correct, then clear, then fast.

> Drift check: Inspect current guidance, canonical scripts and build/package settings before relying on summaries or commands.

## Rules (RFC 2119)

- Copilot MUST read the complete [root agent instructions](../AGENTS.md) before repository planning, changes, reviews or answers.
- Copilot MUST follow their [instruction-loading procedure](../AGENTS.md#instruction-loading), including the complete unconditional global policy and all guidance selected by paths, content and workflow roles.
- Copilot MUST apply selected policies regardless of automatic skill discovery, using their direct-file fallback when needed.

## Scope and Audience

Copilot chat, search and coding responses for this repository. Root and selected policies retain their original scopes, exceptions, quality gates and authority boundaries.
